title: Thermionic Emission
content: The process by which, free electrons are emitted from the surface of a metal when external heat energy is applied, is called thermionic emission.
e: The process by which, free electrons are emitted from the surface of a metal when external heat energy is applied, is called thermionic emission. Heat frees electrons from the cathode, and they travel through vacuum to the anode.

title: Blackbody
content: A blackbody is a perfect radiator of light that absorbs and emits all radiation incident on it.
e: A blackbody is a perfect radiator of light that absorbs and emits all radiation incident on it. A photon's energy is hf, so a shorter wavelength means a more energetic photon involving radiator.

title: Atomic Number
content: The atomic number of an element tells us how many protons or electrons are in an atom of that element.
e: The atomic number of an element tells us how many protons or electrons are in an atom of that element. Z counts protons. A counts protons plus neutrons. Electrons orbit outside involving number.

title: Mass Number
content: The total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus of an atom is called the mass number or the nucleon number.
e: The total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus of an atom is called the mass number or the nucleon number. Mass Number is the quantity of matter, a scalar that does not depend on location. Z counts protons. A counts protons plus neutrons.
